newsitem.title: UK: LME metals surge on fund buying by end PM kerb.
newsitem.headline: LME metals surge on fund buying by end PM kerb.

text.p: ZINC - Powers to fresh seven-year peak of $1,625, ends kerb buoyant at $1,624. Cash/threes at $55 backwardation.
ALUMINIUM - Closes just off five-month high of $1,691.
NICKEL - Breaks out of range, ends at high of $7,180.
COPPER - Finishes touch off high of $2,377.
TIN - Firmer. LEAD - Little affected by excitement.
